LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: L (Ball Bushing Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 50 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 100 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Description:

DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 25 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 30 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Title: SMC SY3401-5U1 5 PORT SOLENOID Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: SY3401-5U1
DESCRIPTION: SY3000, 5 Port Solenoid Valve, All Types (New Product)
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Actuation: 4 (3 Position Exhaust Centre) Mounting/Porting: 0 (Base Mounted) Seal: 1 (Metal) Pilot Specification: Internal Pilot Back Pressure Check Valve: None Pilot Valve: Standard (0.7MPa) Coil specification: Standard Rated Voltage: 5 (24VDC) Light/Surge Suppressor/Common Specification: U (w/Light/Surge Voltage Suppressor, Non-polar) Manual Override: Non-locking Push Type A B Port Size: Base Mounted Valve Thread: Rc (or No Selection in the Case of M5 or One-touch Fittings) Mounting Option: Mounting Screw, Round Head Combination Screw Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: When our R&D engineers redesigned our popular SY 5 port solenoid range, they had one objective - to develop an all purpose solenoid valve range offering impressive functionality. The result is our new Series SY3000/5000. Extremely compact but with outstanding flow rate performance - up to 80% higher than our previous SY models - our new SY range can now operate faster with reduced cycle times. Designed with easy mounting and fast replacement in mind, our engineers have also designed the new SY so that both 3000 and 5000 valve sizes can be used in same manifold thereby providing greater flexibility and economical operation. Available with either rubber or unique metal seal options, the metal seals are particularly suitable for higher operating frequencies and offer extended lifetime performance.
BULLET POINTS: Fluid: Air. Operating pressure range: -100 kPa to 0.7. Ambient and fluid temperature [°C]: -10 to 50 (No freezing). Coil rated voltage [DC]: 24, 12 V. Enclosure: IP67 (Based on IEC60529).

PROPERTIES/VALUES: Size: 1210 (ODdiameter 12 IDdiameter 10) Color: N (Translucent) Roll Length: 20 (20m)
LONG DESCRIPTION: We are pleased to unveil a new advanced flexible, heat and chemical resistant tubing that is chemically compatible with a wide range of fluids and can resist temperatures up to 260°C. The TLM features improved PFA material, which allows use in applications requiring chemical resistance and can withstand fluids that need to be conducted at very high temperatures. It also comes in four different colours – red, black, blue and translucent – so customers can set differently coloured tubes in a visual way to help ease the maintenance and calibration works process, which is required periodically. What is more, we have extended the size and length variations so customers can select exactly what they need in 13 metric and 9 inch options. It can also be ordered in seven different lengths from 2 metres straight up to 100 metre rolls. Developed to be combined with our extensive specific Fittings Series, the addition of the TLM tube provides customers with a complete solution for their piping equipment needs in one single step.

LONG DESCRIPTION: Transferring chemicals has now been made easier thanks to our new two in one TQ Series tubing, providing a total solution in terms of durability and design flexibility. And with both layers being extruded together, no peeling is required offering a quick and easy assembly. Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: Three-Layer Polyurethane - TRTU
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Size: 0604 (6 x 4) Colour: B (Black) Roll Length: 100m
LONG DESCRIPTION: Tubing protection from sparks and weld spatter are some of the most challenging requirements faced in many arc or spot welding applications but, we now have the answer following the launch of a our new three layer flame resistant tube, Series TRTU. Developed initially for the automotive manufacturing industry and suitable for use with both air and water, our R&D engineers have adopted a unique triple layer approach to tube construction by covering an internal polyurethane tube with a middle layer of aluminium laminated film and then adding a final outer layer of polyolefin, which is flame resistant to UL-94 Standard V-O. Designed for use with our Series KR-W2 Flame Resistant or Series KQB2 Metal one-touch fittings ranges, Series TRTU tubing is available in six colour options and with inner tube outside dimensions of 6, 8, 10 and 12.
